title: Neuralese Diffusion: Pre-Registered Cross-Modality Diffusion Interpretability Claims & Falsifications (v1–v2)
domain: Generative Models / Mechanistic Interpretability / Empirical ML
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
summary: Pre-registered claims and falsification ledgers across image, music, video, and 3D tiny diffusion models, transparently logging both verified behaviors and negative/falsified tests (e.g., prompt-swap R4 and video2 failures).
verification_boundary: Empirical pre-registered claims on compact on-device diffusion models; honestly preserves falsified hypotheses.
